# Sales Dashboard Plan for Q1–Q2 Snapshot

A compact dashboard should show volume, revenue, and efficiency side by side so the team can spot growth, soft months, and conversion quality quickly.

## Recommended 3-Chart Dashboard

- **Chart 1: Monthly Orders Trend**
  - Type: Line chart
  - Purpose: Show demand movement across January to April
  - X-axis: Month
  - Y-axis: Orders
  - Data points: Jan 120, Feb 95, Mar 140, Apr 110

- **Chart 2: Monthly Revenue Trend**
  - Type: Line or column chart
  - Purpose: Show revenue performance over time
  - X-axis: Month
  - Y-axis: Revenue
  - Data points: Jan 8400, Feb 7600, Mar 9800, Apr 8800

- **Chart 3: Revenue per Order**
  - Type: Bar chart
  - Purpose: Compare order quality / average order value by month
  - Formula: Revenue ÷ Orders
  - Data points: Jan 70.00, Feb 80.00, Mar 70.00, Apr 80.00

## Trend Analysis

| Month | Orders | Revenue | Revenue per Order |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| January | 120 | 8400 | 70.00 |
| February | 95 | 7600 | 80.00 |
| March | 140 | 9800 | 70.00 |
| April | 110 | 8800 | 80.00 |

- **Orders dipped in February**, then peaked in March, suggesting a recovery in demand after a softer month.
- **Revenue followed the same pattern** as orders, with March as the strongest month and February the weakest.
- **Revenue per order improved in February and April** to 80.00, which suggests higher-value baskets or better pricing, even when order counts were lower.
- **March had the highest total revenue** because it combined the highest order volume with solid average order value.
- Overall, the store appears to have **volume-driven revenue**, with some months benefiting from stronger basket value.

## Metrics to Track Next Month

- **Average Order Value (AOV)**
  Track whether customers are spending more per order, especially after the stronger February and April pattern.

- **Conversion Rate**
  Track visits-to-orders to see whether traffic quality or checkout performance is driving the month-to-month order swings.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build dashboard] https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+design+best+practices+sales+charts
Action: [Button: Add KPI cards] https://www.google.com/search?q=average+order+value+conversion+rate+ecommerce+dashboard

- KPI and dashboard guidance: https://www.shopify.com/blog/ecommerce-kpi
- Revenue and order analytics concepts: https://www.klipfolio.com/resources/kpi-examples/ecommerce
- Chart selection basics: https://www.atlassian.com/data/charts/how-to-choose-a-chart-type
